questions.question: Ebola virus (family Filoviridae) encodes its viral envelope glycoprotein (GP) in a gene that primarily yields a secreted non-structural glycoprotein (sGP). By what mechanism does the viral RNA-dependent RNA polymerase produce the mRNA encoding the full-length transmembrane GP essential for cell entry?
options: By inserting an extra non-templated adenosine residue at a specific poly-uridine site during transcription (transcriptional RNA editing)
By inducing programmed -1 ribosomal frameshifting during translation of the primary mRNA transcript
By recruiting host nuclear spliceosomes to perform alternative RNA splicing of the primary pre-mRNA transcript
By directing post-translational proteolytic cleavage of sGP by host furin proteases to generate GP1 and GP2 subunits

questions.question: Rotavirus is a major cause of severe viral gastroenteritis in young children. Which viral non-structural protein functions as the first identified viral enterotoxin, inducing secretory diarrhea by disturbing intracellular calcium homeostasis and triggering chloride secretion?

Hepatitis D virus (HDV) is a subviral satellite agent with a circular single-stranded RNA genome that requires helper functions from Hepatitis B virus (HBV) to complete its infectious lifecycle. Which HBV-encoded protein component is strictly required for HDV virion packaging and host cell receptor attachment?

Influenza A virus encodes non-structural protein 1 (NS1), a multifunctional virulence factor involved in host innate immune evasion. What is the primary molecular mechanism by which NS1 suppresses host cellular type I interferon expression?
options: Cleaving host RIG-I and MDA5 pattern recognition receptors via an intrinsic cysteine protease domain
Binding host CPSF30 and double-stranded RNA to inhibit cellular pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and polyadenylation
Directly phosphorylating STAT1 and STAT2 to block nuclear translocation of ISGF3 transcription factor complexes
Targeting host RNA polymerase II for rapid proteasomal degradation via an E3 ubiquitin ligase recruitment motif

questions.question: JC polyomavirus causes Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), a fatal central nervous system demyelinating disease in severely immunocompromised patients. Which cell type in the central nervous system is the primary target for productive, lytic infection by JC virus, leading directly to the loss of myelin?
